content: The paper's levels 5-7: 5 Sufis; 6 timefree lettrists; 7 timebound lettrists, for whom the Moon splits through the invention of lettrism by ʿAlī, the Lightbearing Moon; it says the Mafāḥiṣ programme corresponds to level six, and cites the dissertation ch. 6 and pp. 453-61 for the treatise.
